name: Product Ledger Report
query:
SELECT
    sle.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:200",
    sle.warehouse AS "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",
    sle.qty_after_transaction AS "Qty Balance:Float:120",
    sle.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:100",
    sle.posting_time AS "Posting Time:Time:80",
    sle.company AS "Company:Link/Company:120"
FROM
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
WHERE
    sle.docstatus = 1
    AND sle.company = %(company)s
    AND sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(start)s AND %(end)s
    AND (COALESCE(%(warehouse)s, '') = '' OR sle.warehouse = %(warehouse)s)
    AND (COALESCE(%(item_code)s, '') = '' OR sle.item_code = %(item_code)s)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle2
        WHERE
            sle2.item_code = sle.item_code
            AND sle2.warehouse = sle.warehouse
            AND sle2.docstatus = 1
            AND sle2.posting_date BETWEEN %(start)s AND %(end)s
            AND (
                sle2.posting_date > sle.posting_date
                OR (sle2.posting_date = sle.posting_date AND sle2.posting_time > sle.posting_time)
            )
    )
ORDER BY
    sle.item_code, sle.warehouse;
